title: AntiBoatGlitch
description: A plugin for Minecraft that prevents players from glitching through solid blocks using boats by safely teleporting them to the nearest valid surface upon dismount.
body:
# AntiBoatGlitch

## About
AntiBoatGlitch is a lightweight server plugin that eliminates an unfair exploit where players can use boats to glitch through walls and solid blocks. It ensures fair gameplay by automatically repositioning anyone who attempts to abuse this bug.

## Features
- Prevents players from phasing through walls using boat dismount glitches.
- Instantly detects unsafe dismount locations and moves the player to the nearest safe ground.
- Works seamlessly in the background without affecting normal boat usage.
- No configuration required - install and forget.
